正负极接反会损坏硬件。负载的供电电源与通过 USB 操作 voloo 的电脑，请: Reversed polarity damages the hardware. Use separate, independent supplies or adapters for the device and the USB host computer. Never power both from one adapter.

按实物 IN、OUT 和 + / − 标记接线：IN 接电源，OUT 接设备，不: Follow the physical IN, OUT and + / − markings. IN connects to the supply; OUT to the device. Do not rely on left/right positions in an image.

负载供电与 USB 操作电脑必须使用不同的适配器/独立电源。: The device supply and USB host computer must use separate adapters or independent supplies.
即使同一个适配器有多个输出口，也不要同时用于这两路供电。: Different ports on the same multiport adapter do not qualify.
设备只从 voloo 的 OUT 取电。: The device must take power only from voloo OUT.
voloo 控制期间，不要再从设备自己的 USB 口、调试器的 VCC / 3V: Disconnect other power sources, including the device's USB, battery or debugger VCC / 3V3, while voloo controls its supply.
调试器、USB 转串口接到设备时，只连 GND 和信号线。: When connecting a debugger or USB serial adapter to the device, connect only GND and the required signal lines.
电源 A → voloo IN / OUT → 设备；另一电源 B → USB: Supply A → voloo IN / OUT → device. Independent supply B → USB host computer. The device takes power only from OUT, never from the computer's USB or another source at the same time.
